_comment: Every day-over-day move above scripts/check_price_history_integrity.py's MOVE_THRESHOLD_PCT between adjacent IBJA days (<= 4 calendar days apart) in the site's 22K estimate series must be listed here with its cause and evidence, or the check flags it (GG P0 2026-11-05). A move that is not a real event is a splice or basis error and must be fixed, never listed. move_pct is the series' own move; evidence quotes the independent data that confirms it.

moves.cause: market: international gold fell the same day (US-China tariff truce selloff)
moves.evidence: COMEX GC=F close 3344.0 (2025-05-09) -> 3228.0 (2025-05-12), -3.47%; USD/INR 86.08 -> 85.41. yfinance, checked 2026-11-05. Timing: these are US closes; IBJA's 17:00 IST fix on 12 May precedes the 12 May US close, so the check's own previous-close reference reads +0.4% for this day. That the fall was already priced by 17:00 IST is INFERRED (the truce was announced in Asian hours), not measured.

moves.cause: market: international gold rose after the previous IBJA fix, rupee weakened
moves.evidence: Partly confirmed. On the check's own previous-US-close basis: COMEX GC=F 4224.7 (2025-12-10 close, before the 11 Dec fix) -> 4313.0 (2025-12-11 close, before the 12 Dec fix), +2.09%; USD/INR 89.79 -> 90.25, +0.51%; together about +2.6% against the series' +3.2%. The 0.6 pp left is inside the reference's day-to-day timing noise (sd of the landed ratio ~1.1%). yfinance, checked 2026-11-06.

moves.cause: import duty: BCD 5% -> 10% and AIDC 1% -> 5% (total 6% -> 15%), in force 13 May 2026
moves.evidence: Customs notifications No. 15/2026 and 16/2026 dated 12.05.2026 (data/duty_cbic.json). COMEX GC=F flat that day (4686.7 -> 4706.7, +0.43%).

moves.cause: market: international gold fell over two US sessions
moves.evidence: COMEX GC=F 4363.4 (2026-06-08) -> 4286.4 (06-09, -1.76%) -> 4133.3 (06-10, -3.57%). yfinance, checked 2026-11-05. On the check's previous-close basis the reference moved -2.1% that day. Over two days it reconciles: the series 14180 (06-09) -> 13460 (06-11) is -5.1%, COMEX 4363.4 (06-08) -> 4133.3 (06-10) is -5.3%.
